title: Remove ObjectStackKernel legacy code and update to microkernel-only architecture
body:
Post-merge cleanup for #333. Removes backward compatibility layer for deprecated `ObjectStackKernel` monolithic runtime. Codebase now exclusively uses `ObjectKernel` microkernel architecture.

## Code Changes

**Removed:**
- `packages/runtime/src/kernel.ts` - ObjectStackKernel class (230 lines)
- `RuntimePlugin` / `RuntimeContext` interfaces
- Legacy install/onStart lifecycle hooks from all plugins
- Dual-kernel support from `ObjectStackRuntimeProtocol`

**Updated:**
- `mini-kernel.ts` - Removed legacy plugin compatibility checks
- `objectql-plugin.ts` - Removed backward compatibility shims
- `plugin-msw`, `plugin-hono-server` - Now implement `Plugin` interface only

## Documentation Changes

Updated all docs to show microkernel pattern only:
- OBJECTQL_PLUGIN_QUICKSTART.md
- packages/runtime/README.md
- MINI_KERNEL_*.md files
- examples/msw-react-crud/QUICKSTART.md

Removed migration guides and "Before/After" comparisons.

## Breaking Changes

```typescript
// ❌ No longer supported
const kernel = new ObjectStackKernel([
  new ObjectQLPlugin(),
  driver
]);
await kernel.start();

// ✅ Required pattern
const kernel = new ObjectKernel();
kernel
  .use(new ObjectQLPlugin())
  .use(new DriverPlugin(driver, 'memory'));
await kernel.bootstrap();
```

Applications using `ObjectStackKernel` must migrate to plugin-based architecture.
